profile.oneLineIdentity: The party's focus-and-Opportunity battery: a Free-Action, unlimited, zero-cost delivery of a ONE-SHOT Determined (canon: on a failed test add an Opportunity, condition then ends) whose stacked Special riders turn each delivery into +focus, a four-condition scrub, a defence bump or a revive — plus the corpus's only talk-your-way-out-of-a-fight chain — with one flat damage rider, zero movement, zero terrain and zero information. The delivery architecture is NOT unique: heroic/Leader runs the same Key + free-action-delivery + payload-rewrite + multi-target pattern with an outcome-changing payload.

axes.evidence: Exactly one talent deals damage: Mighty (Passive, depth 1, L2) — 'When you hit with a weapon or unarmed attack, for each action spent, deal extra damage equal to 1 + your tier.' A rider on an already-successful attack, flat rather than dice, inheriting the weapon's damage type (Deflect applies). COMPARATIVE CORRECTION: Mighty is not Envoy content — the identical string appears in SIX trees (leyline/Red, heroic/Agent, Hunter, Leader, Warrior, Envoy), so it is shared library filler. Verified: no Envoy talent carries a damage object or damageFormula in all-talents.json (0 roll formulas), matching the census's 0 SOURCE. No other talent in the 25 deals damage of any kind — no Afflicted, hazard, zone, summon or ongoing condition damage. Steadfast Challenge, Calm Appeal and Peaceful Solution all resolve enemies WITHOUT damaging them.

Mighty scales +1 per Tier (2 at Tier 1, 3 at Tier 2) per action spent. Linear in Tier where the benchmark [Tier][Die] is 1d6 (avg 3.5) at Tier 1 rank 2 and 2d8 (avg 9) at Tier 2 rank 3, so its relative contribution SHRINKS with tier. Repeatable every round at no cost — the most reliable damage in the review and the smallest. Guiding Oration's ally advantage is damage-adjacent at best and, per the primer, worth literally zero when the ally already has advantage.

A real single-branch chain: Steadfast Challenge (Action, 1 focus, depth 0/L1 — Discipline vs. Spiritual; on success Disoriented, which per the primer denies reactions and obscures senses), Calm Appeal (depth 2/L3 — converts the Disorient into pacified and taxes resistance by your Discipline ranks of focus), Peaceful Solution (depth 3, Discipline 3+ so L6 — if ALL non-minion enemies are pacified, combat ends), Practiced Oratory (depth 3, Persuasion 3+ so L6 — focus per extra target). A 365-talent scan for 'pacif' returns exactly two talents, both Envoy's; 'end combat' exactly one. HELD AT 3 on comparative grounds: one branch, single-target until L6, contested test, and 'pacified' is defined nowhere in the corpus so its control value is unquantifiable in scope. Per-instance, leyline/Black (Hollow Command then Puppeteer, 'choose one of its actions on that turn') and deity/Power (Kneel then Absolute Authority) are strictly harder control.

Steadfast Challenge is the tree's only state penalty — the target 'gain[s] a disadvantage on tests against you' (corpus: 14 disadvantage producers, 0 consumers). Calm Appeal adds a resource tax: 'Resisting your Steadfast Challenge costs additional focus equal to your ranks in Discipline' — the same design shape as the corpus-wide Baleful (leyline/Blue, heroic/Agent, heroic/Leader), so not distinctive. Two talents, one branch, no defence reduction, no vulnerability, no Weakened/Exhausted.

Four talents, cheap and mostly permanent — three raise DEFENCES (avoidance) rather than mitigating damage. Collected (Passive, depth 0/L1) +2 Cognitive and Spiritual; Customary Garb (Passive, depth 0/L1) +2 Physical and Spiritual while wearing Presentable armor or appropriate clothing — the pair covers all three defences by level 2 for two picks and no cost. Stalwart Presence (Special, 1 focus, depth 2/L3) grants an ally +2 to one defence. Withering Retort (Reaction, depth 1/L2, Discipline 2+) is the ONLY true damage reduction: '+deflect by your ranks in Discipline'. COMPARATIVE: neither passive is Envoy-original — Collected's exact text is in five trees, Customary Garb's in two — but Envoy is the ONLY tree holding both. Above the one-Reaction anchor because of always-on coverage; below 4 because there is no temp HP (14 talents in 9 trees have it; none Envoy's), no interception, no resistance, no redirection.

SCORED ON THE AXIS AS WRITTEN — it counts Health, Focus OR Investiture. On HEALTH alone Envoy is a 1: only Rallying Shout (Passive, depth 3, Leadership 3+ so L6) revives an Unconscious ally and at 0 health restores 'recovery die + your ranks in Leadership'. NOT the corpus's only revive — heroic/Scholar's Resuscitation also revives (and covers 'one who died recently') beside Field Medicine and Swift Healer, so Scholar is the better heroic healer by a distance. Rallying Shout does nothing for an ally at 1 HP. Focus restoration carries the score: Galvanize, Applied Motivation, Lessons in Patience, Inspired Zeal. Held to 3 so the tree is not mistaken for a Health healer, and because the same four talents carry resource_economy.

DOWNGRADED FROM 5. (1) PAYLOAD: canon Determined is 'When you fail a test, may add an Opportunity to the result; condition then ends' (cosmere-canon-reference Conditions table) — a ONE-SHOT token, failure-gated, that does not change the outcome. leyline/White's Shared Conviction ('add your White modifier to their result. This may change the outcome') is strictly stronger fail-insurance, and heroic/Leader's Decisive Command adds a d4+ die BEFORE the roll resolves. (2) ARCHITECTURE IS NOT UNIQUE: heroic/Leader runs the identical pattern — Key (Decisive Command) + free-action delivery (Combat Coordination, which also refunds the focus on a miss) + payload rewrites (Relentless March, Cutthroat Tactics, three command-die enlargers) + multi-target (Authority doubles range AND ally count, free and passive) + Action-granting (Synchronized Assault). (3) THE 12-TALENT COUNT WAS INFLATED: Rallying Shout is a heal, Lessons in Patience is focus, Devoted Presence is a cleanse, and Guiding Oration and Well Dressed are advantage grants the primer discounts to about zero (corpus over-produces advantage 45:7). (4) SATURATION CEILING: Determined ends when used and an ally holds one, so after 3-4 free deliveries the party is saturated. Still a 4: Rousing Presence + Practical Demonstration is an unlimited every-round delivery from LEVEL 1, and no other tree stacks five distinct Special riders (condition scrub, +2 defence, +1 focus, Focused-instead, revive) onto one delivery.

DOWNGRADED FROM 4. Real: Foresight (Passive, depth 3) 'Gain an additional reaction each turn' — one of exactly 2 extra-reaction talents in 365 and the unconditional one (Hunter's Sidestep is Dodge-only and forfeits deflect-2+ armor); it breaks the primer's hard 1-Reaction cap. Practical Demonstration (Free Action, depth 0/L1, no cost) converts the 1-Action Key into a Free Action. Sound Advice acts off-turn; Sage Counsel rides Aid; Practiced Oratory compresses targets; three Specials ride actions already taken. Why not 4: the tree grants NO extra main Action to anyone, and four trees do it better — heroic/Agent buys itself 2 Actions three ways (Quick Analysis, Fast Talker, Trickster's Hand) with 4 Free-Action talents to Envoy's 2; heroic/Leader grants allies an Action (Synchronized Assault) and a free reaction (Through the Fray) and has its own free-action Key delivery; heroic/Scholar's Turning Point grants the party an Action. Foresight is triple-gated: depth 3, Discipline 3+ (L6), and a prerequisite demanding 'a companion' the tree cannot grant.

Read all 25. Not one references movement, speed, teleport, repositioning, standing up, or a Move action. Contrast the near-twin heroic/Leader, which moves itself (Valiant Intervention) and its allies (Relentless March) — the same architecture, with mobility.

Read all 25. No areas, radii, hazards, difficult terrain, walls or persistent features. Practiced Oratory adds TARGETS, not an area; Guiding Oration's 'within 10 ft of your target' is a proximity check on an existing effect.

Read all 25. No detection, scouting, prediction, intent-reading or hidden-fact revelation. Foresight is a misnomer — its full text is 'Gain an additional reaction each turn'. The three expertises are social/downtime competencies, scored elsewhere. Deflation check: no Envoy talent learns, detects or reveals anything, where heroic/Agent (Get 'Em Talking, Close the Case), heroic/Hunter (Sharp Eye) and deity/Fate (Read the Threads) all do.

DOWNGRADED FROM 4. Content: Well Dressed, High Society Contacts, Lessons in Patience (expertise), Steadfast Challenge, Calm Appeal + Peaceful Solution (the corpus's only pacify and only non-violent end of combat, verified across 365), Practiced Oratory. Why not 4: (a) TWO of four social nodes are other paths' talents — High Society Contacts is character-identical to heroic/Agent's, Well Dressed differs from heroic/Leader's by one word; (b) ZERO numeric bonuses to its own social tests, where heroic/Leader adds a command die to Persuasion, Intimidation, Deception, Insight and Leadership rolls plus Set at Odds, Grand Deception, Rumormonger, Well Supplied and Baleful, and heroic/Agent carries seven-plus social talents; (c) the pacify win-condition is combat-scoped and a level-6 pick. A 4 is defensible on the unique end-combat chain alone; 3 is the discriminating score against two named betters.

Three granted expertises (Fashion, High Society, Motivational Speech) plus the focus cluster as an out-of-combat battery between rests and Rousing Presence's scene duration. Minor: no travel, crafting, survival, environmental problem solving, or downtime mechanic beyond the patron requirement. Far behind heroic/Scholar (Erudition grants expertises AND two reassignable skill ranks; Field Medicine) and heroic/Hunter.
Read all 25. No companion, construct, minion or animated ally. Instill Confidence REQUIRES 'a companion' but grants none — a cross-tree dependency, the opposite of a summon.

HELD AT 5, evidence proven, census CORRECTED. A full-text scan of all 365 returns EIGHT focus-restoring talents and FOUR are Envoy's (Galvanize, Applied Motivation, Lessons in Patience, Inspired Zeal); the other four (leyline/Black Siphoned Will and Predatory Insight, heroic/Hunter Cold Eyes, heroic/Leader Cutthroat Tactics) refuel their OWNER only, so Envoy is the corpus's only party-facing focus source and holds twice as many focus talents as any other tree. THE CENSUS UNDER-COUNTS ENVOY and I read the script to prove it: resource-economy.js:35's produce pattern (regain|recover|restore|gain|gains|grant|grants) with word boundaries cannot match Galvanize's 'recovers that much focus' (plural verb outside the alternation) or Lessons in Patience's shipped typo 'recoveres 1 focus' — exactly the two it reports missing as 'Envoy 2'. THE ENGINE: Practical Demonstration (free, every round, from L1) into Rousing Presence into Lessons in Patience (+1 focus) plus Applied Motivation (+half Lore ranks) is an unlimited zero-cost focus faucet, against a pool of 2+WIL where Dodge, Aid and Reactive Strike each cost 1. SECOND CURRENCY the profile missed: Determined itself adds an Opportunity to a failed test, so the same free delivery seeds a currency 17 talents across 9 trees consume. Plus Composed (+tier max and current), Instill Confidence (Focused), High Society Contacts (an Opportunity). Caveat: all four restorers target other characters; Composed is the only self-refuel.

damageTalents.name: Mighty
damageTalents.dice: no dice — flat (1 + Tier) PER ACTION SPENT: +2 per action at Tier 1 (L1-5), +3 at Tier 2 (L6-10). No damage object and no ROLL FORMULA on the document (all-talents.json: damage null, damageFormula empty).
damageTalents.action: Passive (rider on a weapon or unarmed attack)
damageTalents.note: CONDITIONAL RIDER: fires only on a hit with a weapon or unarmed attack, which the tree gives you no help landing. Inherits the weapon's damage type, so Deflect applies — there is no spirit or vital damage anywhere in Envoy. 'For each action spent' multiplies: a 1-Action Strike gets +2 at Tier 1, a borrowed 2-Action attack +4. COMPARATIVE CORRECTION: this is shared library content, appearing with identical text in SIX trees (leyline/Red, heroic/Agent, Hunter, Leader, Warrior, Envoy), so it says nothing about Envoy's identity and is not evidence of offensive design intent.

damageAccounting.peakDamagePerAction: At the deepest reachable point the tree still adds only +3 flat per attacking action (Tier 2). Normalised, one [Tier][Die] is 1d6 (avg 3.5) at Tier 1 rank 2 and 2d8 (avg 9) at Tier 2 rank 3, so Mighty is roughly 0.57 [Tier][Die] at Tier 1 and 0.33 at Tier 2 — its relative contribution SHRINKS as tier rises. Per ATTACK the ceiling is higher because 'for each action spent' multiplies: a borrowed 2-Action attack yields +4 (Tier 1) or +6 (Tier 2), still under one [Tier][Die] at Tier 2. Deflect applies to all of it. No talent adds a die of damage, and none damages a target the Envoy did not personally hit.
damageAccounting.repeatability: Unlimited. Mighty is a Passive with no cost, cooldown or once-per-rest clause, so it fires on every hit of every round forever — simultaneously the most reliable and the smallest damage source of any tree likely in this review.
damageAccounting.verdict: Envoy is a NON-DAMAGE tree, confirmed by two independent streams — the prose classifier scores 0 SOURCE / 1 SRC+AMP, and zero of the 25 talents carry a damage formula. One talent contributes damage; it is a flat +2/+3 per action rider on an attack the tree does not help you land; it is available from L2; and it is a six-tree shared talent rather than Envoy content. Nothing deals damage through a summon, hazard, zone or ongoing condition — Steadfast Challenge, Calm Appeal and Peaceful Solution are explicitly non-damaging resolutions. MITIGATION FALSE POSITIVE: exactly ONE talent could be misread as damage while reducing it — Withering Retort. Three further talents raise DEFENCES (Collected, Customary Garb, Stalwart Presence); those are avoidance, not mitigation, which is why the census scores Envoy MITIG 0. Near-miss: Rallying Shout's 'recovery die + your ranks in Leadership' is a HEAL.

powerByDepth.band: depth 0 — 7 talents, all L1 (Rousing Presence, Steadfast Challenge, Collected, Customary Garb, Galvanize, Practical Demonstration, Sound Advice)
powerByDepth.exemplars: Practical Demonstration + Rousing Presence; Steadfast Challenge; Collected and Customary Garb
powerByDepth.note: Unusually strong entry band, and stronger than the pick-count suggests because the Key is granted with the path (all 11 Keys in the corpus sit outside the prerequisite graph), so a level-1 Envoy holds Rousing Presence plus one chosen talent. Practical Demonstration turns the Key into a free every-round delivery and is the whole engine; Steadfast Challenge is a genuine L1 Disorient plus blanket disadvantage for 1 focus; Collected and Customary Garb hand out +2 across all three defences for two picks and no cost (Envoy is the only tree holding both). Only Galvanize is weak. Every heroic tree has exactly 7 depth-0 talents, so the band SIZE is not distinctive — the quality is.

powerByDepth.band: depth 1-2 — 12 talents (depth 1 at L2: Well Dressed, Withering Retort, Applied Motivation, Composed, Devoted Presence, Lessons in Patience, Mighty; depth 2 at L3: Calm Appeal, High Society Contacts, Stalwart Presence, Guiding Oration, Instill Confidence)
powerByDepth.exemplars: Devoted Presence and Lessons in Patience (the good ones); Guiding Oration and Well Dressed (the bad ones)
powerByDepth.note: The sag, and where the shared-library content clusters: Mighty, Well Dressed, High Society Contacts and Composed are all reprints of other trees' talents (Mighty in six trees; Composed's exact text as Leader's Focused Mind and Scholar's Clear Mind). Devoted Presence's four-condition scrub, Lessons in Patience's free +1 focus per delivery and Instill Confidence's Focused swap are real. Guiding Oration (a frequently-null advantage) and Well Dressed (a once-per-scene advantage, also Leader's) are below the curve. Composed is small but not broken — its live text reads 'Increase your max and current focus by your tier' (verified: description and authoredBody identical in all-talents.json).

powerByDepth.band: depth 3+ — 6 talents, ALL gated at L6 (Peaceful Solution, Practiced Oratory, Inspired Zeal, Sage Counsel, Foresight, Rallying Shout)
powerByDepth.exemplars: Foresight (extra Reaction every turn), Rallying Shout (raise the fallen), Peaceful Solution (the corpus's only end-combat)
powerByDepth.note: The payoffs are genuinely distinctive, though Sage Counsel is a dud and Peaceful Solution almost never fires. CONFIRMED TOOLING BUG, and it is SYSTEM-WIDE, not Envoy-specific: all six carry a rank-3 skill prerequisite (Discipline 3+ x3, Persuasion 3+, Lore 3+, Leadership 3+) and every Envoy row has an EMPTY rankGate field because that field populates only for leyline COLOUR gates — so the dossier's 'earliest L4' understates the band by two levels here and equally in Agent, Leader, Scholar, Hunter and Warrior. COMPARATIVE: Envoy has the largest all-L6 deep band in the heroic atlas — 6 of 6 depth-3+ talents rank-3-gated, against Leader 4 of 6, Agent 3 of 3, Scholar 2 of 3, Warrior 2 of 2, Hunter 1 of 3. Foresight is additionally locked behind Instill Confidence's 'a companion'.

profile.frontOrBackLoaded: Front-loaded engine, back-loaded payoff, with the payoff further away than the dossier says and further away than any other heroic tree's. Envoy is at roughly 80% functional strength by level 2 (the path-granted Key + Practical Demonstration + a defence passive), sags through a middle band of small riders and shared-library reprints at L2-L3, then spikes at depth 3 with effects almost nothing else in the game has — but that spike is a LEVEL 6 event, because all six of its depth-3 talents carry a rank-3 skill gate (the highest proportion in the heroic atlas; Hunter's deep band is mostly L4). None of those gates is recorded in the dossier's rankGate field, which only populates for leyline colours.
uniqueOwnership: SURVIVES CROSS-TREE CHECK — the ONLY tree in the 365-talent corpus that can end a combat without violence: Peaceful Solution ('If all non-minion enemies are pacified, you ase tensions and end combat'), and the only source of 'pacified' at all (Calm Appeal). Scans of all 365 find 'pacif' in exactly two talents and 'end combat' in exactly one, all Envoy's; scans for surrender/flee/retreat/truce/stand down/morale return nothing comparable (deity/Power's Kneel and Absolute Authority compel, they do not end a fight).

SURVIVES, AND IS UNDERSTATED BY THE DETERMINISTIC CENSUS — the party focus battery. Four of the corpus's EIGHT focus-restoring talents are Envoy's, twice any other tree, and they are the only four that restore focus to OTHER characters; the other four (Black's Siphoned Will and Predatory Insight, Hunter's Cold Eyes, Leader's Cutthroat Tactics) refuel their owner only. resource-economy.js reports 'Envoy 2' because its produce regex misses the plural verb 'recovers' (Galvanize) and the shipped typo 'recoveres' (Lessons in Patience).

SURVIVES with a correction to what the buff IS — the Determined tree: Rousing Presence, Instill Confidence and Inspired Zeal are 3 of the corpus's 4 talents naming Determined, and Envoy both PRODUCES it (Rousing Presence; the sole other producer is leyline/White's Collective Resolve) and pays off when an ally SPENDS it (Inspired Zeal). But the canon payload is modest and one-shot — 'When you fail a test, may add an Opportunity to the result; condition then ends' — so this is an Opportunity faucet gated on failure, not a persistent buff. Instill Confidence does not produce Determined; it replaces it with Focused.

SURVIVES — the only unconditional extra Reaction in the game: Foresight. A corpus scan returns exactly two extra-reaction talents; the other, heroic/Hunter's Sidestep, is Dodge-only and forfeits armor with deflect 2+. It breaks the primer's hard 1-Reaction cap with no trigger and no cost — but only from level 6, and only through a prerequisite demanding an out-of-tree companion.

REFUTED — 'the only free-action delivery loop for a Key talent'. It is one of TWO: heroic/Leader's Combat Coordination reads 'After you Strike, use Decisive Command without spending an action. If your Strike didn't hit, you also don't spend focus' — the same loop on Leader's Key, with a focus refund Envoy's version lacks. Practical Demonstration's edge is trigger breadth (a hit OR any Gain Advantage, so it works without a weapon); Leader's fires on any Strike, hit or miss.

REFUTED — 'the only buff whose PAYLOAD is rewritten by stacked Specials'. heroic/Leader does the same to Decisive Command: Relentless March adds movement and Exhausted/Slowed/Surprised immunity, Cutthroat Tactics changes how the die is used, three command-die talents enlarge it, and Authority doubles its range AND ally count for free where Envoy's Practiced Oratory charges focus per target at L6. heroic/Hunter's Seek Quarry has nine consumers, the largest such loop in the corpus. The defensible residue: Envoy stacks the most SIMULTANEOUS riders on one delivery.

NOT UNIQUE, and the profile's list of reprints was too short: SIX of Envoy's 25 talents are shared library content — Collected (identical text in leyline/Blue, leyline/Green, heroic/Agent, heroic/Scholar), Mighty (identical in leyline/Red, heroic/Agent, Hunter, Leader, Warrior), Customary Garb (identical in heroic/Leader), High Society Contacts (identical in heroic/Agent), Composed (identical text to Leader's Focused Mind and Scholar's Clear Mind), Well Dressed (Leader's differs by one word: 'Gain a Fashion expertise'). Reviving the Unconscious is likewise shared with heroic/Scholar's Resuscitation.

NOT A DEFECT, contrary to a tempting structural reading: Rousing Presence's connections [] and zero dependents is a CORPUS-WIDE convention — all eleven Keys (five leyline Attunements plus Opportunist, Rousing Presence, Seek Quarry, Decisive Command, Erudition, Vigilant Stance) have connections [] and no talent anywhere lists them as a prerequisite, because the Key is granted with the path rather than bought.

MINOR BUT REAL — Envoy is the only tree in the corpus holding BOTH Collected and Customary Garb, so it is the only one that can buy +2 to all three defences with two zero-cost depth-0 passives by level 2.
gaps: Movement. Zero. No Move, reposition, teleport, forced movement or escape from Restrained — where its architectural twin heroic/Leader moves itself (Valiant Intervention) and its allies (Relentless March).
Terrain and area control. No zones, hazards, difficult ground or persistent features. Cannot shape a battlefield.
Information. No detection, scouting, foreknowledge or intent-reading. Against an ambush, an invisible enemy or a mystery the tree contributes nothing — despite owning a talent called Foresight.
Damage. One flat +2-per-action rider, and that rider is a six-tree shared talent. Against a target the party must kill on a clock, the Envoy's own contribution is negligible.

Opportunity CONSUMPTION. The engine's real output — a Determined that turns a failed test into an Opportunity — is a currency Envoy cannot spend: no Envoy talent consumes an Opportunity, so the payoff lands only if a partner tree does (17 consumers across 9 trees).

Non-social, non-mindful enemies. SOFTENED from the profile under test: mechanically Steadfast Challenge only needs a Spiritual defence, which every creature has, so it is a GM-ruling risk rather than a certainty. What genuinely requires a pacifiable enemy is Calm Appeal and Peaceful Solution, and with them the Diplomat branch's payoff (the specialty is 8 of 25, verified). Collected, Well Dressed and High Society Contacts function regardless.

Health healing before someone drops. Rallying Shout only works on an Unconscious or 0-HP ally, and it is a level-6 pick. An ally at 1 HP gets nothing; no mid-fight top-up, no temp HP (14 talents in 9 trees have it; none Envoy's), no Injury removal.
Investiture. Zero interaction — the tree neither generates nor spends it, so it gives a leyline or deity partner nothing and gets nothing from Draw Mana.
AoE. Every effect is single-target unless you pay focus per extra target (Practiced Oratory, depth 3, L6) — where heroic/Leader's Authority doubles ally counts for free and passively.

Playing alone. Twelve of twenty-five talents require someone else — Rousing Presence, Sound Advice, Galvanize, Devoted Presence, Stalwart Presence, Instill Confidence, Inspired Zeal, Sage Counsel, Rallying Shout, Guiding Oration, Lessons in Patience, Applied Motivation — and Practical Demonstration is dead alongside them, making thirteen. The remaining TWELVE work solo (corrected from the profile's 'eleven': Steadfast Challenge, Collected, Customary Garb, Well Dressed, Withering Retort, Composed, Mighty, Calm Appeal, High Society Contacts, Peaceful Solution, Practiced Oratory, Foresight), so a solo Envoy is a Disorient/pacify duellist with two defence passives, a deflect Reaction, an extra Reaction and +2 damage.

Refuelling ITSELF. All four restorers name an ally or your target. Eight talents spend focus and the only self-help in 25 talents is Composed's one-off '+tier max and current' — a talent whose text is shared with two other heroic trees.

weakTalents.name: Composed
weakTalents.reason: Increase your max AND current focus by your tier — +1 at Tier 1 — for a whole pick at depth 1. Below the curve, but not as bad as a misread of the authored overlay suggests: the live text (description and authoredBody identical in all-talents.json) keeps the 'and current' clause, so it fills the point it creates, and it is the only self-refuel in 25 talents. Not original content — the identical string is heroic/Leader's Focused Mind and heroic/Scholar's Clear Mind, and leyline/Blue and Black carry the same NAME with the weaker 'maximum focus' text.

weakTalents.name: Galvanize
weakTalents.reason: OVERCOSTED. 2 Actions — a full Fast turn — to give ONE ally a recovery die of focus against a pool capped at 2+WIL. The tree's only 2-Action talent and its worst action rate, and the mandatory gateway into the Faithful branch (Applied Motivation and Composed both list it as prerequisite).

weakTalents.name: Guiding Oration
weakTalents.reason: A depth-2 Passive whose entire payload is an advantage for an ally on their next test against your target. Advantage is BINARY and a second source on the same roll is worth literally zero; the corpus carries 45 producers across 13 trees against 7 consumers, and the ally can Gain Advantage themselves for 1 Action. Frequently null — it exists mainly as the connection between Mighty and Rallying Shout.

weakTalents.name: Well Dressed
weakTalents.reason: An advantage on your FIRST Deception, Leadership or Persuasion test, conditional on clothing — once per scene, in one of three skills, redundant with the standard Gain Advantage action. The Fashion expertise is the only durable content. Not Envoy-original: heroic/Leader carries the same talent, differing by a single word ('Gain a Fashion expertise').

weakTalents.name: Sage Counsel
weakTalents.reason: OVERCOSTED AND REDUNDANT. Depth 3 behind Lore 3+ — a level-6 pick — to spend 1 focus, on top of Aid's own focus and your single Reaction, to deliver Rousing Presence. Sound Advice already does that at DEPTH 0, level 1, for one focus and one Reaction. A deep node reprinting an entry node at double the price; the only difference is timing. Comparative: heroic/Leader's equivalent deep delivery node, Authority, doubles range and ally count for free.

weakTalents.name: Withering Retort
weakTalents.reason: Spends the tree's scarcest slot — your one Reaction, competing with Sound Advice — to add Discipline ranks (1-2 before level 6) of Deflect to a single attack. The attached Steadfast Challenge saves it from never-pick status, but nothing waives Steadfast Challenge's own 1-focus cost: this is a delivery conversion, not a free rider. It stops competing for the Reaction only once you have Foresight, itself a level-6 pick.

weakTalents.name: High Society Contacts
weakTalents.reason: Costs 2 focus — the primer's 'significant' tier and half a starting pool — to add an Opportunity to a test that must be a high-society interaction, in a talent that also demands you already hold a 'Patron in high society' reward. Three simultaneous conditions for one Plot Die nudge, and the talent is character-for-character identical to heroic/Agent's (Agent also carries the parallel Underworld Contacts, Leader the parallel Well Supplied and Rumormonger — library content, not Envoy design).

weakTalents.name: Peaceful Solution
weakTalents.reason: Not weak in effect (it is corpus-unique) but almost certainly a never-fires talent as written. Its trigger requires ALL non-minion enemies to be pacified, and pacifying each costs a successful Steadfast Challenge plus Calm Appeal's focus, one at a time, while they are attacking you. At depth 3 with Discipline 3+ it is a level-6 pick demanding a whole encounter's setup.

weakTalents.name: Calm Appeal
weakTalents.reason: Action-type dishonesty rather than weakness: typed Passive yet carrying a 1-Focus cost and an active spend decision. No standard in DESIGN-GUIDE-CLAIMS.md addresses Passive-versus-spend directly — the nearest is the DEITY guide's Principle 10, about Action versus Reaction — so this is a reading, not a cited violation. At 27 words it is also the tree's longest card against a 20-25 word leyline target. CORRECTED FRAMING: 'pacified' is not a talent-invented condition to blame on this tree — Envoy is an official Cosmere path (its description links Compendium.cosmere-rpg.heroic-paths UUIDs and six of its talents are identical to other paths'), so the state is presumably defined in the published rules, which are outside this review's scope; within the 365-talent corpus it appears here and nowhere else, so its strength cannot be priced.

claims.claim: Envoys further their organisation's reach 'through precise rhetoric, patient attendance, and ceaseless fervor'.
claims.evidence: Steadfast Challenge, Well Dressed, High Society Contacts, Practiced Oratory, Calm Appeal, Peaceful Solution and Rousing Presence are all rhetoric-shaped. Nothing resolves a problem by force; the single damage talent (Mighty) is a six-tree library import bolted to the Mentor branch.

claims.claim: Diplomat — 'adept at navigating court politics... use what they learn about their host countries to seek more favorable treatment'.
claims.evidence: The Diplomat specialty is 8 talents (verified) and its main chain is the tree's COMBAT CONTROL branch: Steadfast Challenge into Withering Retort into Calm Appeal into Peaceful Solution, a Disorient/deflect/pacify chain fought at initiative. Only Well Dressed and High Society Contacts are court politics, both are other paths' talents, and neither 'learns about a host country' — there is no information mechanic anywhere in the tree.

claims.claim: Faithful — 'worship of the divine permeates their entire lives... demonstrating their convictions to others through word or deed.'
claims.evidence: The Faithful specialty contains ZERO divine, religious or devotional mechanics. Its EIGHT talents are Customary Garb (dress-based defence, also Leader's), Galvanize / Applied Motivation / Inspired Zeal (the focus battery), Composed (also Leader's and Scholar's), Devoted Presence and Stalwart Presence (Rousing Presence riders) and Sage Counsel (an Aid rider). Nothing tests, invokes or interacts with a deity, oath, rite or tenet — notable in a system with ten dedicated deity trees to borrow from. Faithful is empirically the focus-economy-and-support-riders branch.

claims.claim: Mentor — 'devote themselves to their wards... patiently nurture others toward greatness'.
claims.evidence: Sound Advice, Lessons in Patience, Instill Confidence, Guiding Oration and Rallying Shout fit — five of eight. But the same specialty houses the tree's two most self-serving talents, Mighty (+damage when YOU hit) and Foresight (an extra Reaction for YOU), and they sit on the branch's main chain (Practical Demonstration into Mighty into Guiding Oration into Rallying Shout), so a player pursuing the ward fantasy is routed through personal-power nodes — one of which is library filler — to reach it.

claims.claim: 'The Envoy key talent, Rousing Presence, unlocks access to the Envoy specialties.'
claims.delivered: NOT MODELLED IN THE GRAPH — but a corpus-wide convention, NOT an Envoy defect
claims.evidence: CORRECTED FROM THE PROFILE UNDER TEST. Rousing Presence has connections [] and prerequisites 'undefined', and no talent lists it as a prerequisite — but all ELEVEN Keys in the corpus are identical: the five leyline Attunements plus Opportunist, Rousing Presence, Seek Quarry, Decisive Command, Erudition and Vigilant Stance all have connections [] and zero dependents. The Key is granted with the path rather than bought, so modelling it as a prerequisite would be wrong. The residual Envoy-specific observation is narrower: nine talents' rules text depends on Rousing Presence, so a multi-path character who dips into Envoy WITHOUT taking the path can legally buy Practical Demonstration or Sound Advice at depth 0 and get nothing.

claims.claim: CROSS-INTENT CHECK (lens d): is this tree's promise also made elsewhere? YES — heroic/Leader.
claims.delivered: SHARED PROMISE, and Leader delivers more of it
claims.evidence: Leader's path description promises 'bolstering fellowship and resolve to carry on' (Envoy's ally-support promise) and a Politico specialty that 'chase[s] favor and prestige while subtly undermining their enemies' (Envoy's Diplomat court-politics promise). Leader delivers the court-politics half with more tools (Rumormonger, Grand Deception, Set at Odds, Well Supplied, plus command dice on Deception/Persuasion/Intimidation rolls) while Envoy's Diplomat branch delivers combat control instead, and Leader delivers the ally-bolstering half with the same architecture and an outcome-changing payload. The two paths share four talents outright and name each other as recommended multi-path partners, so the overlap is designed. Corroborating measurement the profile ignored: functional-overlap.js puts Envoy in the corpus's highest-similarity cluster (Red-Envoy 0.877, rank 2 of 210; Black-Envoy 0.867, rank 4; Envoy-Scholar 0.826) — its FUNCTION vector is not distinctive; what separates it is the pacify chain and the focus faucet, neither of which that metric weights.

claims.claim: 'Attributes. It's usually a good idea to prioritize Presence and Willpower.'
claims.evidence: Willpower is directly served: it sets the focus pool the tree feeds (2+WIL) and the recovery die both Galvanize and Rallying Shout roll. Presence is never named by a talent — the only test is Discipline vs. Spiritual and the scalars are Discipline, Lore, Leadership and Persuasion — but Leadership and Persuasion gate FOUR talents and scale two, and those are canonically Presence-linked social skills. The skill-to-attribute map is not in SYSTEM-PRIMER.md, so this cannot be settled in scope; the cosmere-rpg system's own skill table would settle it. Presence's one primer-stated role, the Investiture pool, is worth nothing here — the tree touches Investiture zero times.

claims.claim: 'Skills. Discipline is essential... other useful skills include Deception, Leadership, Lore, and Persuasion.'
claims.evidence: Discipline gates NINE talents (1+ x1, 2+ x5, 3+ x3) and scales THREE (Withering Retort's deflect, Calm Appeal's focus tax, Inspired Zeal's target count), and the path grants a free Discipline rank. Leadership gates three and scales Rallying Shout's heal. Lore gates two and scales Applied Motivation. Persuasion gates and scales Practiced Oratory. Deception is referenced by exactly one talent (Well Dressed) and gates nothing — the weakest of the five, and notable because heroic/Leader and heroic/Agent both build real Deception mechanics.

claims.claim: 'Rewards. When choosing rewards, you can't go wrong with influential patrons.'
claims.delivered: DELIVERS — and it is load-bearing, not flavour
claims.evidence: High Society Contacts lists 'Patron in high society' as a hard prerequisite alongside Well Dressed. That is a Reward granted at the table, not a talent, so the Diplomat social branch (and Practiced Oratory beyond it) cannot be reached by talent spend alone — but the path description explicitly instructs the player to buy that reward, so it is a designed dependency, not an unplanned dead end. It is the only place in the tree where a GM decision can hard-block a chain.

claims.delivered: NO HEROIC STANDARD EXISTS; against the observed official baseline, one overrun
claims.evidence: Hand-counted and matching the deterministic table exactly: Passive 10 (40%), Special 8 (32%), Action 2 (8%), 2 Actions 1 (4%), Free Action 2 (8%), Reaction 2 (8%), 3 Actions 0. SOURCING: DESIGN-GUIDE-CLAIMS.md contains ONLY the leyline and deity standards; its 'Heroic %' column is a DESCRIPTIVE measurement of 374 official Cosmere talents, not a target, and Revision Principles 2 and 4 are stated for leyline trees. Envoy is an official Cosmere heroic path — its description links Compendium.cosmere-rpg.heroic-paths UUIDs, and six of its talents are identical to other paths' — so no Edha design standard governs it. Against the descriptive baseline: Special, Free and 3-Action land on it, Passive runs 6 points hot and Action 6 points cold. The Reaction overshoot (8% vs 5%) is defensible, because Foresight exists specifically to relieve the primer's 1-Reaction cap.

claims.claim: DESIGN GUIDE — description length target 20-25 words, one core effect per talent.
claims.delivered: DELIVERS (against a leyline target that does not formally bind this tree)
claims.evidence: Envoy runs shorter than target. Word-counted from the live text, exactly TWO cards exceed 25: Calm Appeal 27 (two effects) and Rallying Shout 26; next are Steadfast Challenge 23, Mighty 22, Guiding Oration 22, Well Dressed 21, Practiced Oratory 21. No talent is overdesigned. Data-quality note: five shipped cards carry typos — 'Prsentable'/'Spriritual' (Customary Garb), 'recoveres' (Lessons in Patience), 'you ase tensions' (Peaceful Solution), 'Rousing Resence' (Practiced Oratory), 'Unconcious' (Rallying Shout) — and one is load-bearing beyond cosmetics: 'recoveres' is why resource-economy.js cannot see Lessons in Patience as a focus producer.

intentDrift.actuallyIs: A party focus-and-Opportunity battery with a bolt-on pacification chain, built on an architecture it shares with heroic/Leader. The three specialty labels are close to arbitrary: Diplomat is combat control, Faithful is the resource economy with no faith in it, and Mentor is a mixed ally-support-plus-personal-power branch containing the tree's two most generic imports.

The tree CONSUMES no Opportunity — the 17 consumers across 9 trees are all somebody else's.

Steadfast Challenge; Calm Appeal keys off it. 14 talents across 11 trees produce Disoriented, so the condition is common — Envoy's distinction is the chain hanging off it, not the condition.

mechanicalKeywords.keyword: Skill ranks — Discipline, Lore, Leadership, Persuasion
mechanicalKeywords.role: CONSUMES as scalars and as gates
mechanicalKeywords.talents: Discipline: 9 gates (1+ x1, 2+ x5, 3+ x3) and 3 scalars. Lore: 2 gates + 1 scalar. Leadership: 3 gates + 1 scalar. Persuasion: 1 gate + 1 scalar. The six 3+ gates are what makes the whole depth-3 band a level-6 band — and all six of Envoy's deep talents carry one, the highest proportion in the heroic atlas.
Zero interactions across all 25 talents. Envoy neither generates nor spends Investiture, so it is inert with respect to Draw Mana and the entire leyline/deity economy.

crossTreeHooks: heroic/Leader is the architectural twin and the designed partner — each path description names the other as a recommended multi-path. But four talents are shared outright (Customary Garb, Mighty, Well Dressed near-verbatim, Composed = Leader's Focused Mind), and both trees run Key + free-action delivery + payload rewrites + multi-target, so an Envoy/Leader build buys far less new content than 50 talents implies. They differ in payload: Leader's command die can change a roll's outcome and its riders add movement; Envoy's Determined only pays out on a failure and its riders add focus, cleanse and revive.

Instill Confidence requires 'a companion' — Envoy summons nothing. The whole Mentor deep chain (Instill Confidence into Foresight) is locked behind an outside summon source (Hunter's animal companion, Civilization's Combat Construct, Death's Risen Servant, or a GM-granted NPC).

High Society Contacts requires 'a Patron in high society' — a Reward granted at the table. The Diplomat social branch's payoff nodes cannot be reached by talent spend alone, though the path description's Rewards advice points straight at it.

Practical Demonstration and Mighty both key off 'when you hit with an attack'. Envoy supplies no accuracy, attack talent or damage dice, so the engine's uptime is inherited from a weapon tree (Warrior stances, Hunter). On a pure talker it still fires off Gain Advantage — the one place Envoy's delivery beats Leader's Strike-gated Combat Coordination.

THE OPPORTUNITY SEAM, missed by the profile under test: every Determined Envoy hands out becomes an Opportunity on that ally's next failed test, and Envoy consumes none. That makes it a feeder for the 17 Opportunity consumers across 9 trees — heroic/Agent (Opportunist, Sure Outcome, Double Down), heroic/Scholar (Overcharge, Anatomical Insight), leyline/Black (Predatory Insight), leyline/White (Collective Resolve) — and worth much less beside a party with nothing to spend Opportunities on.

Inspired Zeal only pays out when an ALLY uses Determined — i.e. when an ally fails a test. Its value is set by the party's failure rate, which the Envoy cannot influence, and it can be pre-empted by leyline/White's Collective Resolve.

Guiding Oration's advantage collides with 44 other advantage producers across 13 trees and with the standard Gain Advantage action. Its worth is entirely a function of whether the ally already had advantage — a seam that runs NEGATIVE next to Blue, Red, Green, Agent, Hunter, Scholar or Warrior.

The focus battery is a pure force multiplier on OTHER trees' focus costs — 52 focus consumers against 8 producers, and Envoy's four are the only ones paying out to someone else. Its best partners by focus burn are heroic/Agent (12 costers, 0 producers) and heroic/Leader (11). Beside an Investiture-driven leyline or deity build it does almost nothing.
Devoted Presence's value is entirely reactive to enemy control: it scrubs Prone, Slowed, Stunned and Surprised that someone ELSE applied. Worthless against enemies that do not apply conditions.

Sage Counsel rides the standard Aid Reaction, so it needs an ally actively rolling a test while you hold your Reaction — and it competes with Sound Advice and Withering Retort for the same slot until Foresight lands at level 6.
Foresight's extra Reaction is worth most in a multi-path build carrying more Reactions than Envoy's two — on Envoy alone it just lets Sound Advice and Withering Retort coexist in one round.

Well Dressed and Customary Garb both gate on Presentable armor — an equipment-slot dependency competing with armor a frontline build would rather wear. And because six of Envoy's 25 talents are shared library content, a multi-path build spanning Leader, Agent or Scholar gets no new content from up to a quarter of Envoy's tree.
topThree: Practical Demonstration — Free Action, no cost, depth 0, level 1: converts the 1-Action Key into a free every-round delivery on any hit or Gain Advantage. Its real value is not the Determined but what the riders bolt onto it — with Lessons in Patience it is an unlimited, zero-cost +1 focus per round into the party, plus half your Lore ranks via Applied Motivation. Not unique in kind: heroic/Leader's Combat Coordination does the same for Decisive Command and refunds the focus on a miss.

Foresight — an additional Reaction every turn, unconditional Passive, one of only two extra-reaction effects in 365 talents and the only one with no condition attached. It breaks the primer's hard 1-Reaction cap. Discounted from first place because it is a level-6 pick (Discipline 3+) behind a prerequisite demanding an out-of-tree companion.

Steadfast Challenge — 1 Action, 1 focus, depth 0, level 1: Disoriented (no reactions, obscured senses) plus a blanket disadvantage on everything the target does against you, on a Discipline vs. Spiritual test. Real action denial at the entry band, and the root of the corpus's only pacify chain.
bottomThree: Galvanize — 2 Actions to hand one ally a recovery die of focus against a pool capped at 2+WIL. The tree's only 2-Action talent and its worst action rate, and a mandatory gateway into the Faithful branch.

Sage Counsel — depth 3 behind Lore 3+ (level 6) to spend 1 focus plus Aid's own focus plus your Reaction to deliver Rousing Presence, which Sound Advice already does at depth 0, level 1, for one focus. A deep node reprinting an entry node at double price.

Well Dressed — a once-per-scene advantage in one of three social skills, conditional on clothing, redundant with the Gain Advantage action every character already has, and not original to the path (heroic/Leader carries it with a one-word difference). The Fashion expertise is the only durable content.

sustainability.roundsOfGoodOptions: TWO SEPARATE ANSWERS, and the split is the tree's defining economic fact. (a) The BASELINE loop is INFINITE: Practical Demonstration + Rousing Presence costs nothing and rides an attack or a Gain Advantage you were making anyway, and Mighty, Collected, Customary Garb, Composed, Applied Motivation, Lessons in Patience, Guiding Oration, Foresight and Rallying Shout are all free Passives — a genuine strength no leyline tree can match given Draw Mana's 1-Action-for-1-Investiture rate at Tier 1. CEILING ADDED ON REVIEW: Determined is one-shot and an ally holds one at a time, so after roughly 3-4 free deliveries the party is saturated and the loop's continuing value is the RIDERS (+1 focus, +half Lore, the condition scrub, the defence bump), not the condition — which is why this tree scores higher on resource_economy than on buff. (b) The PREMIUM loop is short: at WIL 2 the focus pool is 4, and the good delivery (Rousing Presence + Devoted Presence + Stalwart Presence, or Steadfast Challenge + Calm Appeal) costs 2 focus per round while Dodge, Aid and Reactive Strike each cost 1 more. Roughly 2 rounds of premium play, 3 at WIL 4. The catch: all four restorers target other characters, so the party focus battery cannot recharge itself; Composed's one-off '+tier max and current' is the only self-help in 25 talents.
sustainability.note: Reactions: 2 of 25 (Sound Advice, Withering Retort) — matches the deterministic table. Under the hard 1-Reaction cap those two compete directly, and Sage Counsel's Aid makes three claimants on one slot; Foresight (depth 3, level 6) grants a second Reaction each turn, so this is the rare tree that supplies its own answer to the cap. TRIGGER-GATED on another creature acting or on being hit — 4 of 25, matching the deterministic count: Sound Advice, Withering Retort, Inspired Zeal, Sage Counsel. Two further talents are STATE-gated and must not be counted here: Devoted Presence and Rallying Shout both fire on YOUR Rousing Presence. A further 5 are self-gated conditionals you control (Practical Demonstration, Mighty, Guiding Oration, Calm Appeal, Peaceful Solution). Resource costs are FOCUS ONLY — 8 of 25 spend focus — so the tree imposes no out-of-tree resource dependency, but equally offers a leyline or deity partner no Investiture interaction at all.
